summary: Tencent's open-source knowledge platform that turns team documents into RAG search, a reasoning agent and a wiki.

heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora.git
cd WeKnora
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up -d

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: WeKnora is an open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework from Tencent for enterprise document understanding, semantic retrieval and reasoning. It brings a team's documents together so they can be searched with RAG, worked on by an agent for multi-step tasks, and organised as a wiki, all on the same knowledge bases.
sixtySeconds.problem: Company knowledge is scattered across files and hard to query. WeKnora turns raw documents into something you can ask questions of and reason over.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a full knowledge platform (RAG, agent and wiki) you can self-host with Docker or Kubernetes, or use online through WeChat.
requirements: Docker, Docker Compose and Git for self-hosting

overview: Three ways to use it: online via the WeChat Dialog Open Platform (connect Q&A to Official Accounts and Mini Programs), a Tencent Cloud Lighthouse template, or self-hosted with Docker or Kubernetes.
For self-hosting, clone the repo, copy .env.example to .env and edit it, pull the images and start the core services, then open http://localhost and follow the onboarding guide.
The docs Quickstart has a walkthrough with sample data. WeKnora is MIT licensed, apart from listed third-party components.
